nodes.title: How to use — W5 v14 (SPEED TEST)
widgets_values:
## W5 v14 — first frame + video (SPEED TEST)
= v13 + **INT8 attention for the video model** (node *Model Attention Backend* → `comfy kitchen attention`; native, the same idea as SageAttention). Set it to `pytorch attention` to get exactly v13.

v13 = v12 with a **weaker ControlNet: strength 0.6, end 0.5** (v12: 1.0 / 0.7). v12 painted the skeleton lines on the body and clothes.

v12 = v11 (production 2/3) made faster. Goal: ~27 min → ~10 min with little quality loss.

**What v12 changed vs v11 (kept here):**
1. **Turbo ON** with the official 8-step LoRA `minimax_h3_fl2v_turbo_8step_v1.0`, **8 steps** (v11: 20 steps, no LoRA). Turbo OFF = 20 steps without LoRA.
2. **First frame 1088×1920** (~2.1 MP; v11: 1536×2720).

Everything else = v11 (896×1600, 124 frames, same seeds and prompts).

**Fill in:** video name `<product>_<pose>`, product photo, catalog POSE `motion/poses/<pose>/pose.mp4`.

**Output** in `output/motion/W5_v14/<name>/`: `frame0_*.png` and `video_*.mp4`.
**Expected time:** less than v13 (video 7 min; frame0 comes from cache if v13 already ran). Note the times of each stage.

**Compare** with the approved v9 video (side by side) before promoting to production.

Tip: right-click a group title → *Set Group Nodes to Never/Always* to turn a stage off.

widgets_values_named.text:
## W5 v11 — first frame + video (PRODUCTION 2/3)
Same settings as the approved base (v9: ControlNet end 0.7). The skeleton comes ready from the catalog; this workflow does not extract poses.

**Fill in:**
1. **Video name** — `<product>_<pose>` (e.g. `caramel-tank-jeans_look-02`). Becomes the output folder.
2. **Product** — front photo, full body, model wearing the garment.
3. **Catalog POSE** — `motion/poses/<pose>/pose.mp4`. It shows up in the list after running W1 and `catalog.py pose <pose>`.

The pose for the first frame is frame 0 of the same pose.mp4.

**Output** in `output/motion/production/<name>/`: `frame0_*.png` and `video_*.mp4` (896×1600, 124 frames, 24 fps).
**Time:** ~27 min on an RTX 4090. Run nothing heavy in parallel.

**Then:** `catalog.py compare <name> <pose>` (original | skeleton | generated) and `catalog.py upscale <name>` for W6.

Tip: right-click a group title → *Set Group Nodes to Never/Always* to turn a stage off.
